title: Compute Alternating Sum
description:
You are given an array nums.

Compute the alternating sum:

nums[0] - nums[1] + nums[2] - nums[3] + ...
Rule
Add elements at even indices (0, 2, 4, …)
Subtract elements at odd indices (1, 3, 5, …)
Task

Return the final alternating sum.

Examples

Example 1

[1,3,5,7]
→ -4

Example 2

[100]
→ 100
Constraints
1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 100
1 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 100
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
